visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a macro close-up of several dark, textured black truffles resting on a bed of white uncooked rice within a plastic container. A pair of hands enters the frame, carefully lifting a white tissue paper covering the truffles to reveal them more clearly. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Transition to a medium shot of a pink paper cup labeled 'WTF TEA EXPRESS.' A person's hand uses a long metal spoon to stir a brown liquid inside. Shortly after, a thick, white creamy liquid is poured from a pitcher into the cup, filling it to the brim. (3) The camera focuses on a wooden truffle shaver as a hand slides a black truffle across the blade, sending thin shavings onto the frothy surface of the drink. Multiple cups are shown in a line, receiving the same treatment. Golden flakes are added as a final garnish. (4) A man wearing a black t-shirt and a black baseball cap with a white logo appears, smiling and gesturing towards the camera. He hands the finished drinks to a group of young women on a busy city street. The background shows blurred shopfronts and pedestrians in winter clothing. (5) Montage of customers and friends posing with their pink cups, smiling broadly, and taking photos with smartphones. The man in the cap interacts warmly with them, exchanging greetings. The lighting is natural daylight on an overcast day. (6) A brief indoor scene shows three small dogs—a fawn French Bulldog, a brindle French Bulldog, and a dachshund—playing on a blue blanket next to a dog bed. The man is seen in the background pouring more drinks. (7) The video concludes with a close-up of a single pink cup with the gold leaf and truffle shavings on a wooden table. Text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen signaling the end of the segment.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 male assistant, approximately 10 female customers and friends in various scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged man with short hair, wearing a black t-shirt and a black New Era baseball cap with an NBA logo. He has a friendly and approachable demeanor.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a professional tea shop counter with stainless steel equipment, a busy urban street with traffic and storefronts, and a cozy indoor room where dogs are playing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a vibrant, mid-tempo pop-jazz track featuring a rhythmic bassline and bright piano chords. A distinct, high-frequency rhythmic 'scuffing' sound occurs as truffles are shaved. No vocals are present initially. Ambient noise is low studio quality. (2) A male voice enters with moderate intensity and a friendly, upbeat tone, saying 'Xiexie' (Thank you). The music continues at a steady volume in the background. A soft 'splash' sound is heard as liquid is poured into a cup. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor environment. A burst of high-arousal female voices is heard cheering and laughing ('Wah!'), mixed with the distant hum of city traffic. The male speaker's voice remains dominant as he converses with others, his speech rate moderate and intonation rising. (4) A series of short, percussive 'clinks' from spoons and cups punctuate the music. The background music maintains its upbeat tempo. Vocal density increases as multiple voices overlap in a celebratory 'Happy Valentine's Day' greeting in Mandarin. (5) The final phase returns to a more focused musical layer. The ambient crowd noise fades, leaving the jazzy music and a final professional-sounding male narration. The audio ends with a clean fade-out of the music track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional vlog for 'WTF TEA EXPRESS,' showcasing a luxurious truffle-infused milk tea. It highlights the meticulous preparation process and the positive emotional response from customers during a Valentine's Day event. The inclusion of the creator's personal touch and interactions with friends/customers creates a sense of community and brand warmth.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video prominently features the brand 'WTF TEA EXPRESS' on cups, uniforms, and through on-screen text, focusing entirely on a specific product and its successful distribution.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The contrast between high-end truffles and a popular street beverage (milk tea) is used as a strong visual hook. The fast-paced editing and upbeat jazz music maintain high viewer engagement.
